Title: Ekom Mailchimp
Description: Mailchimp for Ekom stores. It supports audience tags and subscriptions, tracks completed purchases, and queues Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) messages.

AuthorDetails.Name: Vettvangur
AuthorDetails.Description: Vettvangur is a digital agency in Iceland that builds and maintains Ekom.

RelatedPackages.Description: The Ekom e-commerce package that this integration extends.
